name: surfsense-local-electron
description: Electron shell: spawns the API + worker sidecars, loads the Vite SPA
author: SurfSense

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n vite,electron -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --dir ../frontend dev" "wait-on tcp:127.0.0.1:5173 && electron-vite dev"
scripts.dist: pnpm build:frontend && pnpm build:binaries && pnpm build:model && pnpm build:ollama && pnpm build && electron-builder
